items.title: John L. Jones Interview, 1972-06-05
items.q: Frank, me, Frank Crump, John Porter, we had one time Lana of Tarragana or Albert Giles or somebody like that. We had four piece, we used to go to Boothville.

ctx.x: I never met him. I don't know anybody.

He was an outdoor saxophone player. Frank, me, Frank Crump, John Porter, we had one time Lana of Tarragana or Albert Giles or somebody like that. We had four piece, we used to go to Boothville. Friday, Saturday, Sunday, man had a place for us to stay down there. Drink that orange wine.
What about, you were telling me about the Rinky Dinks.
